# product-bench

Draft discovery plans, prototypes, PRDs with Gherkin acceptance criteria, design specs and engineering projects from a product brief. Every output is a draft a person approves.

An [Agent Plugin](https://agent-plugins.org) bundling 7 agent skills.

## Install

Agent Plugins is a portable format, so installation is handled by each client.
See the [list of compatible clients](https://agent-plugins.org/compatible-clients)
for setup instructions, and point your client at this directory.
